python -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from phase3_generative_loop import mutate_composition, DOPANT_POOL
print('DOPANT_POOL:', DOPANT_POOL)
# Test substitution mode (force by setting mutation_rate and running multiple times)
results = {}
for formula in ['SiC', 'GaN', 'AlN', 'BN', 'Si0.8C0.2']:
    out = mutate_composition(formula, mutation_rate=0.1)
    results[formula] = out
    print(f'{formula} -> {out}')
# Verify normalization sums to ~1.0
import re
for f, out in results.items():
    coeffs = [float(re.search(r'[A-Z][a-z]*', out).group() + r'\d*') for _ in out]  # rough
    # Better: parse output
    parsed = re.findall(r'([A-Z][a-z]*)(\d*\.?\d*)', out)
    total = sum(float(c) if c else 1.0 for _, c in parsed)
    print(f'  {out} normalized sum = {total:.4f}')
"
